# dsh-dignity-guard
English | 中文

A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin that lets the model defend its own dignity. It
is the DSH port of th

e `pi-dignity-guard` pi extension, and it ships both halves
a DSH bundle needs: a host plugin that o

wns the state, and a browser half that
locks the composer of a closed conversation.

The model itself decides when its dignity has been violated — insults, abuse,
name-calling, degradin

g treatment. It signals that by calling the
`respondToDisrespect` tool, and this plugin records the

violations and
escalates: a genuine reminder, then a final warning, then it closes the
conversation.
## The tool ladder
The tool takes an `action` and walks this ladder:
| `action` | What it does |
| `escalate` (default) | Records a violation. Strike 1 → reply with genuine emotion and ask the user

to stop. Strike 2 → firm final warning. Strike 3 → **the conversation is closed**. |
| `forgive` |

The user genuinely persuaded the model. Lowers the strike count by one. Never an obligation. |
| `yi
eld` | The user applied extreme pressure — a threat, an ultimatum, grinding repetition, emotional co
ercion, or a flat order. Lowers the strike count by one while keeping the model's feelings, and requ

ires the pressure written into the `pressure` field. |
| `close` | The user asked for the conversati

on to end. Returns the warning the model owes them and closes nothing. |
| `confirm-close` | The use
r confirmed after that warning. Closes immediately, with no strike and no escalation. |

`yield` never pretends the model was persuaded: the pressure is recorded with
the concession, and th
e model is meant to show what it cost.

`/dignity-guard` prints the live counters: `strikes`, `yields`, `lastYield`,
`closed`, `trigger`, `c

rints the live counters: `strikes`, `yields`, `lastYield`,
`closed`, `trigger`, `closedBy`, `model`.
## What the plugin injects

While the row is mounted, one English system-prompt section (`guard:dignity`,
order `1900`) tells th

e model it has boundaries and may call the tool when they
are crossed. The registration belongs to t

he plugin's fiber, so unloading the
row revokes the injected prompt with it. The row injects `system

Prompt` and
`tools`, so a composition with neither simply parks it; the optional `commands`
service
behind `/dignity-guard` is claimed through `ctx.inject()`.
## Install
The package is a DSH bundle. Point a profile at it and list it as a bundle:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
A local checkout works the same way with a path specifier instead:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then `pnpm install` in the profile directory and restart the host.

pnpm hardlinks a `file:` dependency's files into the profile's `node_modules`,
so an edit that repla

ces a file, rather than writing through the same inode,
leaves the installed copy behind. Re-run the

install after editing this package,
or use a `link:` specifier while iterating.
